How are you?
Okay.

So um for example, one of my work, I installed the hologram on the floor and that floor takes about one thousand square feet space.

Uh this piece uh has been traveled to many different countries and currently uh showing in Finland and most of the time it was in the museum space and kind of keep traveling now.
Yeah.
What's your background?
Is your background uh more as an artist or in science and technology?
Uh fine arts, my background.
Fine arts.
What drew you to holography?
Were you involved with another medium first and uh sort of like changed over to holography or was holography your first love?
Well, um yeah, uh before as artist I kind of you know, play with all different medium like a painting or sculpture, those things.
Um but it's kinda I always feel like a two dimensional painting, they are too flat, too D and the uh sculpture to me is also kinda a little too real.
So until about ten years ago when I first time I saw hologram, I finally found these two elements, these two quality can be combining together.
Yeah.

Yes I do.
Um I have my studio in Manhattan.
Oh, okay.
Yeah, um what do you have inside what type of uh laser systems are you working with right now?
I have uh uh Hinam Niang uh laser and also um a a big table for that.
The table weighs two thousand pounds.
Yeah.
Um so and also some other size facilities.

It's a fifty million one.
Fifteen.
Fifty mil okay, uh one twenty five uh spectra.
Yeah, you know pretty well.
Okay.

But but frustration never really coming from the limitation because I do feel maybe different other holographer, I do feel there's still so many things you can do uh for this medium.
And um you know apply to different ideas.
There's so many art, you know, things I haven't done yet.
Um and you know, if sometimes you get frustrated maybe because like uh you know, every good work it requires so many um you know, requirement like a stability or temperature whatever so many things.

But other than that I'm pretty happy.

So sometimes I feel it's kinda like a even like a film production.
